title: Why “the new zealand herald” is trending in NZ: 200+ searches, the facts (November 06, 2026)
description: “the new zealand herald” is trending in NZ with 200+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Impact PR - Public Relations and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “the new zealand herald”
paragraphs: “the new zealand herald” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for NZ (snapshot taken 2026-11-06T00:16:02+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Impact PR - Public Relations, NZ Business Magazine, NZ Herald. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “The AI bubble just burst. Here’s what it means for NZ – Liam Dann” — NZ Herald
“Kiwi SMEs are using AI. Can AI find them?” — NZ Business Magazine
“AI Search Visibility Could Cost NZ Firms More Than $300m” — Impact PR - Public Relations

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:00:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-06T00:16:02+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-06T00:16:41+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
